items.title: The composition of two affine morphisms is affine
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)

items.difficulty_reason: The claim is that for affine morphisms f : X to Y and g : Y to Z the composite g composed with f is affine (statement lines 1969-1972). The proof is a four-line verification of the defining criterion: it takes an arbitrary affine open U of Z, uses affineness of g to make the preimage in Y affine, applies affineness of f to that affine open, and rewrites the result as the preimage under the composite (proof lines 1974-1979). It is H2: the argument is complete and self-contained and the only input is the standard affine criterion, so no H3 claim would be honest here, and the value of the item lies in the faithful short proof rather than in difficulty.
